summary: Streams the active or locked Photoshop document into TouchDesigner over Photoshop Remote Connections.

key_params.name: active
key_params.note: Receive image data from Photoshop while enabled.

key_params.name: address
key_params.note: Photoshop host address; localhost works on the same machine.

key_params.name: password
key_params.note: Password configured in Photoshop Remote Connections.

key_params.name: imageformat
key_params.note: JPEG for update rate or uncompressed RGB for quality.

key_params.name: locktocurrent
key_params.note: Fill Locked Document Name from the current Photoshop document.

key_params.name: unlock
key_params.note: Clear Locked Document Name so the active Photoshop document is followed.

key_params.name: maxupdaterate
key_params.note: Maximum update rate in automatic mode.

common_gotchas: Photoshop must have Remote Connections enabled with a matching password before TouchDesigner can connect.
JPEG improves update rate but sacrifices image quality; uncompressed RGB is heavier but higher quality.
Manual update mode only refreshes when the Update pulse is clicked.
If Locked Document Name is empty, the TOP follows the active Photoshop document, which can change during editing.
key_concepts: Streams the output from Photoshop into TouchDesigner over Photoshop Remote Connections.
Photoshop may run on the same computer or another networked Windows or Mac computer.
Remote Connections must be enabled in Photoshop with a matching password before the TOP can connect.
An empty Locked Document Name follows whichever Photoshop document is currently active.
